evidence: Modifies ChainstateManager::LoadGenesisBlock() in src/validation.cpp to control how the node restores block file info and reads existing genesis data.
rationale: Fixes silent block data corruption and broken `-reindex` on platforms without `posix_fallocate()` such as OpenBSD, NetBSD, and OmniOS. When the block index is missing, startup unconditionally rewrote the genesis block, zero-filling subsequent blocks on disk and stalling reindexing at height 0 (#33128).
